author: Lintuxer
tagline: The keyboard-driven file manager, in a browser tab
description: superfile is a terminal file manager built for the keyboard: multiple panels side by side, fuzzy search, batch rename, compress and extract, a metadata pane and previews for text, images, video and PDFs. This package ships the upstream release binary together with ttyd, so the whole thing runs in a browser tab against the shares you mount into it — no client to install, no separate terminal. Press "?" inside for the hotkeys. Access is protected by HTTP basic authentication; anyone who gets in can also run shell commands from superfile's command line, so treat the password as a password to the machine, not to an app.

tips.before_install: Change SPF_PASSWORD before installing — the value in this file is public, and it guards a terminal that can delete the files you mount. Keep the published port off 7681: ZimaOS runs its own web terminal there. The mounts under /files are exactly what the app will be able to reach.

title: Superfile
